description: This file defines a Dart service class named DashboardService for a Flutter app, which interacts with Firestore to observe and compute dashboard statistics related to tasks, such as tasks due today, this week, overdue, completion rate, and distribution by project and tags.

classes.name: DashboardStats
classes.description: Immutable data class representing various statistics for the dashboard, such as tasks due today, this week, overdue, completion rate, and distribution maps for tasks per project and tag.

classes.name: DashboardService
classes.description: Service class providing real-time streaming of dashboard statistics by listening to task changes in Firestore and computing aggregate metrics.

methods.name: watchStats
methods.description: Returns a stream of DashboardStats objects that update in real time as task data changes in Firestore.

methods.name: _computeStats
methods.description: Internal method that processes a list of TaskItem objects to compute aggregated dashboard metrics.
